title: Use Company Badges to Identify the Company

features.name: Company Badges
features.description: Visual badges assigned to companies for quick identification across multiple companies and environments. Users can customize badge colors, text, and style to distinguish between different environments and companies.
caveats: Company badge text limited to six characters
Shape of badge determined by environment type - round for production, square for sandbox

features.name: Environment Type Badge Shape
features.description: Round company badges signify production environments while square company badges signify sandbox environments to help users quickly identify the environment type.
